payload.supporting_quote: Significant differences were found between TSH, FT4I, DHEA-S, ACTH, testosterone, and cortisol/DHEA-S ratio in MDD patients compared to the healthy controls.
Plasma DHEA-S levels in patients were significantly higher than those in healthy controls.

payload.comparison_population: subjects with very-mild-to-moderate depression vs. severe depression
payload.symptoms: symptom severity (BDI score), especially guilt and failure
payload.supporting_quote: In subjects with very-mild-to-moderate depression, the DHEA-s level increased as BDI score did. However, the DHEA-s levels in the subjects with severe depression were significantly lower than in subjects with moderate depression.
